pte.name: PTE Academic
pte.description: English test with Speaking and Writing, Reading, and Listening.

sections.title: Reading
taskTypes: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

taskTypes.name: Read Aloud
taskTypes.description: Read a written prompt aloud clearly and naturally.

taskTypes.name: Repeat Sentence
taskTypes.description: Listen to a sentence and repeat it exactly as accurately as possible.

taskTypes.name: Describe Image
taskTypes.description: Describe the key information in an image using connected speech.

taskTypes.name: Retell Lecture
taskTypes.description: Retell the main points of a lecture after listening to it.

taskTypes.name: Answer Short Question
taskTypes.description: Answer a short question with a brief spoken response.

taskTypes.name: Summarize Group Discussion
taskTypes.description: Summarize the key ideas and differing views in a group discussion.

taskTypes.name: Respond to a Situation
taskTypes.description: Give an appropriate spoken response to a described situation.

taskTypes.name: Summarize Written Text
taskTypes.description: Write a single-sentence summary of a written passage.

taskTypes.name: Write Essay
taskTypes.description: Write an essay in response to an academic prompt.

taskTypes.name: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks
taskTypes.description: Complete blanks in a passage by selecting appropriate words from drop-down lists.

taskTypes.name: Multiple Choice, Multiple Answers
taskTypes.description: Select all answers that correctly answer the question.

taskTypes.name: Reorder Paragraph
taskTypes.description: Arrange text boxes into a coherent paragraph sequence.

taskTypes.name: Reading: Fill in the Blanks
taskTypes.description: Drag words into the correct gaps in a passage.

taskTypes.name: Multiple Choice, Single Answer
taskTypes.description: Select one correct answer after reading a text.

taskTypes.name: Summarize Spoken Text
taskTypes.description: Write a summary of a spoken recording.

taskTypes.name: Multiple Choice, Multiple Answers
taskTypes.description: Select all answers supported by the recording.

taskTypes.name: Fill in the Blanks
taskTypes.description: Type the missing words while listening to a recording.

taskTypes.name: Highlight Correct Summary
taskTypes.description: Choose the summary that best represents the recording.

taskTypes.name: Multiple Choice, Single Answer
taskTypes.description: Choose one correct answer based on the recording.

taskTypes.name: Select Missing Word
taskTypes.description: Select the word or phrase that completes the recording.

taskTypes.name: Highlight Incorrect Words
taskTypes.description: Identify words in a transcript that differ from the recording.

taskTypes.name: Write from Dictation
taskTypes.description: Type the sentence you hear as accurately as possible.

sat.name: Digital SAT
sat.description: College admissions test with Reading and Writing and Math.
sat.acceptedInstitutions: All US Colleges & Universities, Oxford, Cambridge, NUS, McGill

gre.name: GRE General
gre.description: Graduate test with Verbal Reasoning, Quantitative Reasoning, and one Analytical Writing task.
gre.acceptedInstitutions: Thousands of Graduate & Business Schools Worldwide

gmat.name: GMAT Focus
gmat.description: Business school test with Quantitative Reasoning, Verbal Reasoning, and Data Insights.
gmat.targetAudience: MBA, Executive MBA, Masters in Finance / Management
gmat.acceptedInstitutions: Stanford GSB, Harvard, Wharton, INSEAD, LBS & 2,400+ Business Schools

toefl.name: TOEFL iBT
toefl.fullName: Test of English as a Foreign Language (Internet-Based)
toefl.description: English test with Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing.

act.name: ACT Assessment
